newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Fargo estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Fargo estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst George Salem cut the 1997 cash basis estimate on Wells Fargo to $22.25 per share from $23.00 and cut the 1998 estimate to $26.50 per share from $27.60
-- Analyst says buy rating is maintained "especially for investors with the patience to see through some near-term earnings shortfall."
-- "The large, complicated merger of First Interstate and Wells has apparently had major execution glitches," analyst says
-- Wells Fargo off 2-1/2 to 255 in mid-afternoon
